sources: By layering Resulticks' customer data and AI capabilities onto the core ESG/compliance infrastructure, Diginex can now serve enterprise customers across two distinct workflows:
Sustainability & compliance (carbon accounting, ESG reporting, supply chain transparency)
Customer intelligence & marketing (Resulticks' core strength — AI-driven customer data platforms)

prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: pale cyan. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them. Every cutout is matte paper reflecting only the room light, with a plain blank face: coin rims, document faces, screens and vehicle sides carry no lettering, numerals or marks.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons, tape, rubber stamps, string and pins, stencilled arrows, paper bar charts, stacked sheets, grid paper, torn strips, hole-punched tags, paper clips, in cream, black, pale yellow or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture and print dots.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip: one line, no wider than a third of the frame width, with safe margins, the chip sitting clear of the subjects. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw. When the beat marks a hero number, that number alone may be printed larger, up to half the frame width.
8. Compositions vary in scale from beat to beat: some show one oversized subject filling the frame, some a small subject alone on open ground, some several elements arranged as a diagram.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: pale cyan.
Subjects: two grid paper panels; a stencilled arrow.
Opens on the bound block, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip is covered as the bound block splits into two grid paper panels; a stencilled arrow enters and runs from one panel to the other, then stops.
Ends holding on the two panels.
This composition is a diagram: several elements are arranged together.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "2 WORKFLOWS".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "2 WORKFLOWS". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Diginex can now serve enterprises across two distinct workflows.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, 2D-animated modern editorial paper collage style. The scene opens with a static shot of a flat, pale cyan paper background. The lighting is consistent, coming from the upper left, casting small, soft, realistic shadows beneath every paper layer. At the very start, a bound block of paper from a previous composition is visible in the center; immediately, it splits apart with a fast motion and slight overshoot into two separate, rectangular grid paper panels—matte white with light blue grid lines and rough, white torn-paper edges. Simultaneously, a cream-colored paper chip with an extra-bold black sans-serif typeface descends into the upper third of the frame, displaying the clean, legible text "2 WORKFLOWS". Below the headline, a flat matte cream paper stencilled arrow slides in quickly from the left, its point traveling from the first grid panel to the second before coming to a stable stop. All elements are matte, reflecting soft room light, and the grid panels remain blank and unmarked. The camera remains in a locked Static Shot throughout. S1, a narrator with a warm, clear, and natural mid-range adult voice, speaks in an off-screen voiceover with a brisk but unhurried delivery: <d>[English] Diginex can now serve enterprises across two distinct workflows.</d> The on-screen elements hold their final diagram composition for the remainder of the video, with a very subtle, slow looping drift to maintain life.

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by a clean, dry studio recording of a human voice. Beneath the narration, synchronized diegetic sounds of paper include a crisp "slap" as the grid panels split and a tactile, sticky friction sound of adhesive tape as the arrow slides into place.
